programme.desc: 鷺航客運飛行部副部長顧南亭（王凱飾），以嚴苛自律和鐵血上司的形象深受眾人敬畏與之形成鮮明對比的是貨運女飛行員程霄（譚松韻飾），她性格爽朗不羈，即將晉升機長的她卻因公司改制被降至客運部的觀察員，重新踏上飛行之路命運的玩笑是，顧南亭成了程霄的直屬上司和導師，兩人的相遇註定了不尋常的火花ampampampampltbrampampampampgt顧南亭習慣於秩序和規章制度，而程霄卻喜歡不按常理出牌，經常讓他應接不暇一系列突發的航空事件接踵而至，要求他們合作應對，但他們的分歧和火藥味卻似乎更加激化了每一場危機顧南亭面對這位性格如此迥異的飛行員，既感到挑戰，也因其勇敢和獨立而歎為觀止在冰火交織的挑戰中，顧南亭和程霄必須找到一種合作的默契，才能化解每一次的險情，確保安全的背後他們的故事不僅僅是師徒間的碰撞，更是對於個性與團隊合作之間微妙平衡的探索

programme.desc: 鷺航客運飛行部副部長顧南亭（王凱飾），以嚴苛自律和鐵血上司的形象深受眾人敬畏與之形成鮮明對比的是貨運女飛行員程霄（譚松韻飾），她性格爽朗不羈，即將晉升機長的她卻因公司改制被降至客運部的觀察員，重新踏上飛行之路命運的玩笑是，顧南亭成了程霄的直屬上司和導師，兩人的相遇註定了不尋常的火花ampampampampltbrampampampampgt顧南亭習慣於秩序和規章制度，而程霄卻喜歡不按常理出牌，經常讓他應接不暇一系列突發的航空事件接踵而至，要求他們合作應對，但他們的分歧和火藥味卻似乎更加激化了每一場危機顧南亭面對這位性格如此迥異的飛行員，既感到挑戰，也因其勇敢和獨立而歎為觀止在冰火交織的挑戰中，顧南亭和程霄必須找到一種合作的默契，才能化解每一次的險情，確保安全的背後他們的故事不僅僅是師徒間的碰撞，更是對於個性與團隊合作之間微妙平衡的探索

programme.desc: 劇集改編自紀靜蓉的小說如果奔跑是我的宿命，由鍾楚曦楊超越許娣陳小藝侯雯元領銜主演 該劇透過一場車禍，講述了兩個家庭如何在人生的逆境中展現出不同的生活態度和勇氣ampampampltbrampampampgt一次喜慶的壽宴後，一場意外的車禍對趙秀麗（陳小藝飾）和趙秀芳（許娣飾）的家庭造成了破壞性的打擊趙秀麗的兒子是一名成績優異的高中生，但在這場事故中不幸喪生，大女兒陳若華（楊超越飾）逃過一劫；而趙秀芳的女兒程安心（鍾楚曦飾）是一位年輕的舞蹈教師，也在這次事故中重傷失去了雙腿陳若華為了幫助母親趙秀麗從悲痛中恢復過來，將她帶到了自己的學生宿舍然而，陳若華在照顧心碎的母親和處理與周凱澤（王宥鈞飾）的戀情之間，感到極大的壓力另一方面，趙秀芳為了振奮失望的女兒程安心和逃避現實的女婿秦峰（宋洋飾），決定開始之前從未成功過的減肥隨著時間的推移，陳若華在與母親的關係中逐漸找回平衡，解開了母女之間的矛盾趙秀芳也最終成功地減掉了體重，幫助程安心重新勇敢面對生活

programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

자막 신 테니스의 왕자 U-17 WORLD CUP 결승 멤버 결정전

짱구는 못말려 10
programme.desc: 조금은 건방지고 장난을 좋아하는 5살 유치원생 신짱구가 주인공으로, 부모님은 물론 주위의 어른들이 짱구가 일으키는 장난들에 휘말리고 마는 일상을 재미있게 그린 코믹 애니메이션. 투니버스에선 2001년 첫 방영을 시작하였으며, 현재까지도 시청자들에게 가장 큰 사랑을 받고 있는 작품 중 하나이다. 특히, 이번 lt짱구는못말려10gt은 짱구 출판 20주년, 방송 10주년을 기념하여 방영되는 시즌으로, 국내에선 한 번도 공개되지 않은 새로운 시즌이 방영될 예정이다.

programme.title: 신비아파트 고스트볼 X의 탄생 두번째이야기
programme.desc: 귀염뽀짝 NEW 도깨비 금비를 만나기 위해 금비가 사는 동굴로 향하는 하리와 친구들! 하지만, 도깨비 금비가 살던 동굴에서 봉인된 귀신들이 현실세계로 나가는 사건이 발생하고, 이 사건을 계기로 금비는 기억을 잃고 마는데... 현실세계로 풀려난 500여년 전 원혼들에 맞서 싸우는 하리와 친구들, 거기에 금비의 비밀까지... 우리가 몰랐던 도깨비들의 진짜 이야기가 시작된다!

programme.title: 上陽賦
programme.desc: 皇權腐朽，貴族奢靡，不顧百姓生死郡主王儇，與初戀三皇子子澹青梅竹馬，卻因預言得之得天下，被捲入朝堂爭鬥，成為父親的一顆棋子，嫁給出身寒門的豫章王蕭綦大婚之夜，蕭綦被迫離開京城，王儇蒙羞，心灰意冷賀蘭王子綁走王儇向蕭綦尋仇，夫妻二人因禍得福相知相愛王儇被蕭綦守護天下子民盛世太平的心願感動二人因王謝兩族爭權太后陷害致夫妻流落分離兩人歷經萬苦重聚，滅叛軍，平邊境賀蘭族之亂在叛將謀反時，王儇拼死將無心皇位的子澹護送出京，保他平安王儇帶兵守城，九死一生，終於堅守到邊境平亂的蕭綦趕回最終，夫妻倆攜手開創新紀元，共同守護家國百姓

programme.title: 商道
programme.desc: 19世紀紅頂商人林尚沃的發跡傳奇，大長今團隊經典之作原本立志成為譯官的林尚沃，卻因一場冤案家破人亡，淪為官奴他毅然投身商道，從基層夥計一步步崛起，憑藉過人的智慧誠信與膽識，在商戰中屢破困局，與宿敵鄭治壽展開跨越半生的競爭，也與命運多舛的多寧譜出刻骨銘心的愛情尚沃始終堅守以義取利的信念，更以商業改善民生造福百姓，最終成為朝鮮第一商人，譜寫出商海不朽傳奇

programme.title: 神醫喜來樂首
programme.desc: 經典好戲為您呈獻！最有人情味的人物風骨，充滿市井氣的生活畫卷清朝末年，滄州郎中喜來樂開立醫館一笑堂，常以奇方怪招治人，默默暗戀對門食為天飯館的老闆娘賽西施，使夫人胡氏時常醋意大發京城王爺的愛女被太醫診斷得了絕症，正焦急發愁，卻被喜來樂用難登大雅之堂的旁門左道救活，自此，開啟了喜來樂一家進京行醫跌宕起伏的精彩人生

programme.title: 英雄訣
programme.desc: 燕王朱棣從小就表現出驚人的毅力和膽識，是眾兄弟中最出類拔萃的一個，但因為不是長子而無緣太子位太子朱標意外亡故後，朱元璋立皇孫朱允炆朱棣被削藩逼得無路可退，無奈起兵，在長達四年的靖難之役後，終於入主京師朱棣擁有了天下，卻背上了千古罵名，也失去了心中的摯愛朱棣用後半生的勵精圖治改寫大明的歷史，營建紫禁城，遷都北京，五次親征漠北，編成永樂大典，派遣鄭和下西洋，建立了不朽功績當他最後一次徵北時病逝於凱旋的歸途中

programme.title: 包青天首
programme.desc: 宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱包青天，為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調人在做天在看舉頭三尺有神明不畏強權，除惡務盡

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇

programme.title: 新蜀山劍俠
programme.desc: 西晉五胡之亂時期，各國混戰蜀山，西蜀偵探兵狄明奇誤入血魔禁區，獲南海派劍仙丁引救出狄明奇求丁引收自己為徒遭到拒絕，後遇丁引師弟曉如與徒弟一真，並和峨眉老祖長眉合力鎮魔長眉以法寶昊天鏡鎮住血魔，但曉如被血魔化出魔血附身四人逃出魔窟，前往瑤池仙堡治傷，從而展開一場惡戰

programme.title: 龍爭虎鬥
programme.desc: 少林高僧有兩名天份過人之弟子，長徒韓（石堅 飾）已背叛師門專作不法勾當，幼徒李（李小龍 飾）受到師傅委託，參加比武大會，師兄弟在一場龍爭虎鬥之後，韓倒在一長茅尖端上，了結一生罪惡

programme.title: 等一個人咖啡
programme.desc: 九把刀小說改編大學新鮮人思螢在神祕美麗老闆娘營業的等一個人咖啡店打工，她暗戀著看似身邊女友不斷的咖啡店常客澤于，卻總是遠遠等著他某天店裡來了風雲人物阿拓學長，兩人很快成為好朋友，思螢的生活因為阿拓出現而多彩多姿，當阿拓決定離開台灣實現夢想，思螢開始疑惑自己心中所等的人，真的是澤于嗎？

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之鐵雞鬥蜈蚣
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻結識尋找妹妹的鐵燕父女，鐵燕父女發現朝廷的捕快正和僧人在商議販賣人口的計策但不料行蹤被發現，結果父親被打傷，女兒只好逃出去向黃飛鴻求救

programme.title: A計劃
programme.desc: 二十世紀初期，香港海盜橫行，盜魁羅三炮與奸商周永齡互相勾結，官府為之束手水警沙展馬如龍不滿官府政策憤而辭職，與道上名賊卓一飛合謀對付海盜，惜卓一飛唯利是圖，二人合作屢剿失利馬如龍心有不甘，遂重新加入水師警隊，與上司洪天賜卓一飛三人合力喬裝闖入匪巢，終將海盜一網打盡

programme.title: 小曉新
programme.desc: 小曉是一位活在自己世界的女孩，因為一個令人揪心的秘密，她在學校被同學霸凌孤立，媽媽薇芳也視她為麻煩，在國外長期工作的爸爸更像既熟悉又遙遠的陌生人，唯有班導保羅能理解並舒緩她的情緒但一次颱風天下課，小曉目睹了媽媽與班導的秘密，困惑的她不僅必須強迫自己適應這個複雜的情感關係，也逐漸發現原來她與媽媽都有各自對生活說不出的無奈飾演小曉的林品彤破紀錄於12歲入圍並榮獲第60屆金馬獎影后

programme.title: 困獸
programme.desc: 為了有效降低社會犯罪率整頓已經紛亂不堪的地下博彩業，政府聯合警方和博彩協會，嚴密展開打擊地下賭場的行動，並將新建賭場經營權拍賣處理以肅清博彩業，但不為人知的利益和秘密，卻引發賭城風雲與各方人馬衝突

programme.title: 夜半歌聲
programme.desc: 1926年的北京，青年演員宋丹平（張國榮飾）因主演歌劇迷倒成千上萬女性，卻與清純富家女杜雲嫣（吳倩蓮飾）墜入愛河然因戲子身份遭杜父反對，杜雲嫣被禁閉在家，許配給某豪門顯貴訂婚夜宴上，杜雲嫣佯病離席私會宋丹平，未婚夫發現後妒火中燒，派人毒打宋丹平並放火焚燒劇院杜雲嫣自此成為外人眼中的瘋婦，而已成廢墟的劇院每逢月圓之夜總傳來虛無縹緲的歌聲

programme.title: 作弊神槍手
programme.desc: 阿布瓦是一個代考槍手集團的首領，專門在銀行醫學工程等領域的入職考試提供作弊方案，賺取了上千萬的利潤為了解決弊端，政府以警督阿迪亞為首成立特別小組阿迪亞曾是阿布瓦最好的朋友，如今兩人站在法律的對立面，阿布瓦終究會落入法網，還是逃出生天呢？

programme.title: 偉大的隱藏者
programme.desc: 北韓南派組織的3名間諜，爲了完成任務分別僞裝成智障搖滾青年和高中生潛伏於南韓鄉下，發生一連串既搞笑又驚險刺激的諜戰故事長時間在南韓的生活，以及受到善良熱心鄰居的影響，讓他們逐漸對自己的信念產生質疑

programme.title: 舞樂傳奇35,36首
programme.desc: 舞樂傳奇35,36首

programme.title: 東方禿鷹
programme.desc: 美利堅合眾國國防部1987年第一號秘密軍事行動代號東方禿鷹行動執行者林中校於聯邦監獄抽選一批華裔刑事重犯組成雜牌軍，負責明修棧道之任務；楊上校則率領華裔精練部隊負責暗渡陳倉任務但上帝未眷顧此一行動，在空難事故中，精練部隊出師未捷身先死，林中校唯有率領雜牌軍空降北越，強渡關山，向死神挑戰

programme.title: 法海：白蛇傳說
programme.desc: 藥師許仙採藥途中偶遇修煉千年的白蛇，一人一妖互許終身豈料白蛇卻在兩人飲酒慶祝後現出原形，遭不知情的許仙用法刀刺傷，且負傷離去許仙得知真相後悔恨不已，前往雷峰塔盜取仙草拯救白蛇，卻遭妖靈附身而被高僧法海帶往金山寺服下仙草功力倍增的白蛇怒闖金山寺想帶走許仙，與法海展開一場死鬥

programme.title: 鹿鼎記II神龍教
programme.desc: 龍兒（林青霞飾）重返神龍教繼承教主之職位，並奉命保護平西王吳三桂（秦沛飾）之子吳應熊（湯鎮業飾），前往京城晉見康熙（溫兆倫飾），並在麗春院巧遇韋小寶（周星馳飾）及阿珂（李嘉欣飾）康熙賜婚，命小寶護送建寧公主（邱淑貞飾）下嫁至雲南

programme.title: 大稻埕
programme.desc: 大學生佑熙及歷史系豬教授陰錯陽差穿越時空，回到了1920年代台灣最繁華的大稻埕兩人不僅意外捲入了日本皇太子蒞台蔣渭水抗爭等歷史上至關重要的大事件，更分別跟性格強悍獨力開了間裁縫店的奇女子阿純，以及風華絕代色藝雙全的首席藝旦阿蕊，展開了甜蜜纏綿的跨時代戀曲

programme.title: 神話
programme.desc: 秦朝玉漱公主頻頻入夢，困擾著考古學家杰克，使他更醉心研究秦朝古物為解開夢境之謎，杰克來到西安的懸浮天宮，同時亦有各路高手為奪寶而來，天宮寶物被撬開，天空之城因而失去懸浮能力，成千上萬的兵馬俑從天而降，杰克受一股神秘力量牽引跳入萬丈瀑布睜開雙眼，出現的竟然是夢中人玉漱公主！

programme.title: 人潮洶湧
programme.desc: 小劇場演員陳小萌的人生窮困潦倒，事業一敗塗地，有一天，他去澡堂泡澡，竟意外的讓殺手周全摔倒失憶，演員和殺手交換了身分，從醫院醒來的殺手失去記憶，誤以為自己是走投無路的演員，在偶然結識的單親媽媽李想的幫助下，他重新認識作為演員的自己，探索前進的方向，在這過程中他和李想的內心也悄悄發生變化

programme.title: 36總局
programme.desc: 巴黎街頭出現一群窮凶惡極的匪徒，犯下多起血腥暴力的攻擊事件，警方卻遲遲抓不到兇手警界盛傳只要將這幫惡人緝拿歸案，就能接替巴黎刑警局局長之大位而警局裡最有勝算的兩大警探，里奧為求破案不惜包庇線人，卻意外捲入謀殺案；丹尼則因過於服從上級，導致隊友因公殉職激烈的爭權鬥勢，讓他們兩人迷失在道德邊界，這場權力戰爭將何去何從？

programme.title: 潛龍突擊隊
programme.desc: 一群海豹突擊隊，在飽受戰爭蹂躪的東歐國家有東歐火藥庫的波士尼亞鎮守而駐守在這國家閒來發慌的五大神兵，聽聞近郊湖底埋著價值美金三億的黃金，他們私下出動直升機秘密偵測開坦克橫行街頭，只為揭開隱藏的巨大寶藏

programme.title: 凸槌大歷險3：世界大尋寶
programme.desc: 大家齊聚麥熊家迎接小熊寶寶，竟送來一隻羊駝寶寶！麥熊與好友打算把羊駝寶寶送回爸媽身邊，殊不知羊駝家收到的居然是袋鼠寶寶！夥伴們踏上環遊世界的尋寶之旅，穿越墨西哥馬雅金字塔澳洲廣袤草原非洲吉力馬札羅山和中東浩瀚沙漠，最終來到中國！小熊寶寶究竟在哪裡？一家團圓的希望能實現嗎？

programme.title: 愛在回家時
programme.desc: 金牌獵人頭專員丹面對唯利是圖的公司老闆高壓管理，夜以繼日地工作，能夠陪伴妻子及三個孩子的時間寥寥無幾直到大兒子意外檢測出癌症，讓丹終於正視長久以來妻子的怨言及失衡的生活，他開始減少工作陪伴愛子抗癌，卻面臨對手業績一路領先，奮鬥許久的事業岌岌可危重重壓力導致身心俱疲，丹不得不找出自己心中最重要的事物究竟是什麼？

programme.title: 疾凍救援
programme.desc: 在加拿大北部一處偏僻的鑽石礦坑發生重大坍塌意外，一群礦工被埋在坑道內，僅剩30小時的氧氣可以存活一支緊急救難隊靠著巨型卡車橫越300英哩結冰湖面構成冰路，救出被困住的26名礦工但他們真正的威脅卻是過去從未遇過的恐怖危機，原來礦坑企業公司為了隱藏爆炸意外主因被揭發，竟雇用大批殺手阻撓救難隊員行進，一場驚天動地的救難行動在冰天雪地中就此展開！

programme.title: 毒謀
programme.desc: 一群躲過納粹大屠殺的猶太倖存者，並沒有因為戰爭結束而忘記對加害者的仇恨他們集結成群，動用私刑獵殺前納粹軍官但僅僅如此還不能滿足復仇的渴望，倖存者們決定施行能大規模造成德國人死傷的攻擊計畫，以牙還牙，以眼還眼，六百萬條命換六百萬條命成為他們的唯一信念！

programme.title: 殺戮特遣隊
programme.desc: 面對隊上弟兄的家人遭到襲擊，一群前精英部隊士兵再次展開任務，一場無情的殺戮遊戲就此展開

programme.title: 2047死亡地帶
programme.desc: 西元2047年，地球由聯盟政府執行高壓統治，萊恩是反抗軍組織－綠色戰役的成員，他奉命去收集聯盟政府進行種族屠殺的證據不料這一切被聯盟政府發現，政府派出阿西莫夫上校與菁英部隊追捕萊恩及其組織然而當形勢急轉直下之際，萊恩遇到了屠殺倖存女孩圖瓦格，圖瓦格是否能讓形勢逆轉，與萊恩一同拯救被聯盟政府奴役的世界？

programme.title: 聖保羅大劫案
programme.desc: 擁有龐大勢力的黑幫老大魯本斯，決定在養女莉歐妮亞的協助下，最後再大幹一票但在聖保羅的銀行搶劫行動中，出乎意料的情況發生了，魯本斯和莉歐妮亞在巴拉圭銷贓後，兩人陷入了危機本片改編自真實事件

programme.title: 人生消極掰
programme.desc: 大學教授理查，某日被醫生診斷只剩六個月可活絕望的他回到家，正打算告訴妻女這件事時，卻反而得知妻子出軌女兒出櫃再次遭受打擊的他，在大罵人生真該死之後，決定拋棄一切道德束縛盡情享受越亂越快樂的人生他開始瘋狂酗酒吸毒濫交，狂野舉止讓妻女都傻眼不已不過他這堂放飛自我不合常規的另類人生課程，卻意外啟發他眾多學生

programme.title: 異類崛起
programme.desc: 一顆隕石墜落在紐約州一個農業小鎮，將空氣毒化，小鎮生物開始死亡外星生物學家蘿倫被國土安全部徵召去尋找這起神祕事件的答案時，一棵異世巨樹生長在隕石撞擊的地點，原來這顆隕石是被送往地球尋找新家的實驗種子，來自一個垂死的世界，巨樹則是為了在地球上創造適合他們居住的環境，進而展開殖民，人類正處於大規模滅絕的生死邊緣

programme.title: 獵魔人
programme.desc: 英雄法爾達以及所屬的組織成員，數百年來守護人類免於來自地獄惡魔的危害他的首要任務，就是在世界末日前，阻止各路惡魔與恐怖的怪物入侵人間

programme.title: 戰狼堡壘1：守門人
programme.desc: 2039年的未來，世界秩序分崩離析，各國的盟約規則平靜生活全都搖搖欲墜，世界正面臨全新的戰爭2039年的戰狼部隊將投入一個遭受全新邪惡科技所掌控的新世界，由卡謬布拉塔夫所率領的戰狼部隊轉而成為秘密行動組織，他將首次面對超乎理解的未知敵人

programme.title: 戰狼堡壘2：襲擊者
programme.desc: 因一場行動失去戰袍而悲痛萬分的戰狼部隊，必須設法找出神秘的攻擊者，並要面對敵人強大的軍事武裝設備

programme.title: 特務殺很大
programme.desc: 一名罹患絕症的特務，接到組織交付的機密任務，該任務可以換取搶救他生命的藥物，但他一直隱瞞家人的特務身份也將被揭穿為了活命，特務不惜在巴黎殺出一條血路

programme.title: 獵空計畫
programme.desc: 育有一兒一女與妻子共組完美家庭的空軍中校歐列格，以及即將與妻子迎接新生命的空軍上尉康斯坦丁性格和生活截然不同的兩人，因為政府的決定，共同被派駐至敘利亞的空軍基地執行任務兩人在戰場上合作無間立下功勳，卻在一次摧毀敵方火箭發射器的行動中，因不慎掉入敵方的陷阱，兩人雖然逃過一劫但也性命垂危

programme.title: 童心馬戲團
programme.desc: 10歲的瑟希樂跟母親剛回到鄉下，她還不太適應那裡的生活這時正好來了一組巡迴馬戲團大家爭先恐後，都想一睹小馬波力的風采然而瑟希樂卻發現波力受到主人柏卡魯的虐待她想拯救波力她將波力藏了起來，不讓大人發現，並且意外地獲得神秘的維托及村裡其他小孩的幫助為了逃脫柏卡魯的追尋，瑟希樂跟波力展開了一段充滿驚喜的冒險

programme.title: 守龍者
programme.desc: 自古相傳，應龍族保護風調雨順，而守龍者和他們命運相連，現世僅剩被囚禁的兩條龍與最後一個守龍者萍，為了拯救倉鼠夥伴，萍深入洞穴，與丹紫露雨的相遇意外解開她的真實身份守龍者能量覺醒，萍也收到嚴峻的任務：將最後一顆龍蛋送往育龍潭孵化，一人一龍的冒險成長之旅就此開啟

programme.title: 終極殺陣2：雷霆霹靂
programme.desc: 飆速計程車重現江湖啦！丹尼爾初次與岳父母共進午餐，適逢日本國防部長出訪法國，身為國防部長的岳父必須親自到機場迎接，丹尼爾的首要任務就是在飛機降落之前將岳父平安送達機場不料順利完成任務後，警探好友艾米里再度擾局，原來日本國防部長竟被恐怖份子綁架了！為了搶救日本國防部長並挽回法國的國際形象，艾米里只好再度請出飛車駕駛丹尼爾協助破案！

programme.title: 詐欺女王
programme.desc: 瑪拉利用法律手段，將特定老人族群當成目標，先成為其法定監護人，讓他們住進護理機構，再封鎖對外求助管道，最後偷走他們的財產，不動聲色地完美犯案某天，她鎖定下一個肥羊，成功讓對方掉入自己精心佈下的騙局隨後，她竟發現這位看似完美的肥羊，似乎不如表面所見的那樣單純？

programme.title: 死神騎馬來
programme.desc: 十五年前的梅斯塔牧場，比爾一家人慘遭搶匪集團滅門，只有小比爾被一名晚到搶匪藏於馬車下而逃過一劫親眼目睹家人慘死的比爾，多年來苦練槍法一心復仇，在追查的過程中遇上甫出獄的中年牛仔瑞恩，兩人似乎有著共同的目標，帶著既像競爭又像合作的方式將匪徒逐一揪出擊斃，而比爾也漸漸發現瑞恩其實隱藏著一段秘密

programme.title: 十三太保
programme.desc: 唐末，黃巢起義軍攻入唐首都長安，晉王李克用受命剿賊，收覆都城沙陀族人李克用其時擁兵十萬，麾下猛將如雲，更有義子組成的十三太保能征善戰，風光一時其中十一太保史敬思與十三太保李存孝武功最為高強，令梁王朱溫極其忌憚而設宴暗算最終，昔日威震天下的大同邊將戰死大半，令人唏噓

programme.title: 非誠勿擾2
programme.desc: 秦奮決心與笑笑白頭到老，笑笑對秦奮的感情卻止於好感，在秦奮好友的離婚典禮啟發下，兩人決定先從試婚開始然而秦奮深沉的愛意卻對笑笑帶來無形的壓力，兩人只能分道揚鑣距離遠了，感情好像也就淡了，在兩人似乎已忘記對方的同時，他們生活的軌跡又再次交錯，在好友點化下，笑笑似乎明白了婚姻的真諦

programme.title: 雷瑪根鐵橋
programme.desc: 二戰末期盟軍已攻至德境萊茵河彼岸直指德國心臟地帶，猶作困獸之鬥的希特勒下令炸毀各座跨河大橋，而盟軍也計畫炸橋後可將德軍分隔兩岸削弱其兵力納粹軍官克魯格少校奉命至雷瑪根擔任萊茵河最後一座鐵橋的守備指揮官，肩負最後一刻執行炸橋的艱鉅任務，然而到任後克魯格發現德軍因敗退而軍令紊亂，正規部隊早已被調往他處，後備部隊只剩不到二百人，更糟的是連炸橋用的炸藥都還遲遲未能送達

programme.title: 十三太保
programme.desc: 唐末，黃巢起義軍攻入唐首都長安，晉王李克用受命剿賊，收覆都城沙陀族人李克用其時擁兵十萬，麾下猛將如雲，更有義子組成的十三太保能征善戰，風光一時其中十一太保史敬思與十三太保李存孝武功最為高強，令梁王朱溫極其忌憚而設宴暗算最終，昔日威震天下的大同邊將戰死大半，令人唏噓

programme.title: 藍徽特攻隊
programme.desc: 一戰末期德軍在西部前線戰事吃緊，畢業於104飛行學校的史達赫中尉來到了威利上尉的飛行中隊當時飛行員最高榮譽是擊落敵機二十架可獲頒藍色徽章史達赫在首次任務就擊落英軍飛機一架，卻未得到陸軍證實而不算，但史達赫的戰功並未因此停滯不前；最終，史達赫榮獲最高榮譽，卻在授予藍色勳章那天，有人向元帥爆料史達赫紀錄不實的內幕，中隊長決定把他送至柏林軍事法庭究責

programme.title: 無敵幸運星
programme.desc: 曹家大老爺去世，留下家族企業及遺產給在法國念書的女兒飛飛管理，飛飛的大哥及堂哥心懷不軌欲將遺產占為己有大哥無意間救起落海的鳳，發現鳳與飛飛長相一模一樣，讓鳳假扮飛回家星在夜闖曹家行竊時被逮個正著，情急之下謊稱暗戀飛多年，將計就計與堂哥合作打算與飛結婚，順理成章分遺產

programme.title: 戰略大作戰
programme.desc: 二戰盟軍在法國南部遭遇德軍頑強抵抗，美軍偵察前鋒部隊擄獲一名德軍情報局上校為長官背黑鍋而被拔除中尉官階的士兵凱利，灌醉上校後套出德軍藏匿大筆金條要後送柏林，於是開始招兵買馬說服隊上弟兄長官，準備利用即將到來的三天假期，進行一場神不知鬼不覺的敵後奪寶大作戰！

programme.title: 少林寺
programme.desc: 清朝初年禁武，少林寺預感將有大劫，遂廣收方世玉胡德帝蔡德忠等俗家弟子，因材施教傳授絕學，培養反清復明種子眾弟子學成下山復仇後，清兵在叛徒馬福儀引路下包圍少林弟子們聞訊趕回誓死護寺，與清兵展開慘烈決戰最終少林寺被一把大火付之炬盡，但倖存弟子殺出重圍，將少林武學與反清火種傳播至世間

programme.title: 非誠勿擾3
programme.desc: 笑笑答應秦奮求婚後，因追求公益事業離家十年，研究出智慧型機器人的老范為解秦奮相思之苦，設計了一個外表酷似笑笑並植入二人美好回憶的機器人笑笑送給了他在秦奮逐漸深陷AI笑笑的溫柔鄉時，真笑笑突然歸來，兩個笑笑一個敢怒一個敢言，讓秦奮一個頭兩個大，頻頻被虐三人相處笑料與火藥味十足

programme.title: 大進擊
programme.desc: 二戰期間，英國轟炸中隊於巴黎上空執行轟炸任務，其中一架轟炸機被德軍擊中，飛行員被迫跳傘逃生，並約好在清真寺旁的土耳其浴室會合其中三名英軍分別降落在動物園水池歌劇院，以及正在重新粉刷的納粹祕密警察總部屋頂，在動物園管理員歌劇院樂團指揮與油漆工幫助下逃生而樂團指揮和油漆工，更陰錯陽差隨著三名英軍飛行員，與德軍展開了一場場驚險刺激的逃亡之旅！

programme.title: 少林寺
programme.desc: 清朝初年禁武，少林寺預感將有大劫，遂廣收方世玉胡德帝蔡德忠等俗家弟子，因材施教傳授絕學，培養反清復明種子眾弟子學成下山復仇後，清兵在叛徒馬福儀引路下包圍少林弟子們聞訊趕回誓死護寺，與清兵展開慘烈決戰最終少林寺被一把大火付之炬盡，但倖存弟子殺出重圍，將少林武學與反清火種傳播至世間

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產雙語版
programme.desc: 拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子 老父親再婚年輕單親媽80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 惜花芷
programme.desc: 世家千金經商勇敢為家族撐出一片天，張婧儀攜手胡一天立下終身之約！！京城望族花府忽遭抄家流放，被拆散的家族只徒留老弱婦孺守家門花家長女花芷從不過問家中世事，出面嶄露經商鋒芒撐起家中生計，帶著眾女重返家族光榮原以為自己不好惹的名聲傳遍京城將孤獨一生，遇見了七宿司司使顧晏惜成為彼此的救贖也向她許諾終身

programme.title: 熱血軍檢首
programme.desc: 安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力揭露真相在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事

programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 惜花芷
programme.desc: 世家千金經商勇敢為家族撐出一片天，張婧儀攜手胡一天立下終身之約！！京城望族花府忽遭抄家流放，被拆散的家族只徒留老弱婦孺守家門花家長女花芷從不過問家中世事，出面嶄露經商鋒芒撐起家中生計，帶著眾女重返家族光榮原以為自己不好惹的名聲傳遍京城將孤獨一生，遇見了七宿司司使顧晏惜成為彼此的救贖也向她許諾終身

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產雙語版
programme.desc: 拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子 老父親再婚年輕單親媽80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向

programme.title: 熱血軍檢首
programme.desc: 安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力揭露真相在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 八年愛情遇上現實 婚後生活秒變修羅場劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房沒車沒鑽戒沒婚禮的裸婚兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力揭露真相在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: The Race to Challenge Chinas EV Lead

programme.title: The Race to Merge AI With Humanoid Robots

programme.title: AI Is Pushing Chipmaking to Its Limits

programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dads birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Andy and the Alamosaurus
programme.desc: Jen is carried away by a weather balloon and Andy sets out on an epic adventure across Dino Island to rescue her. Along the way, they meet the mighty Alamosaurus.

programme.title: Pockets
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit Patch in the Cloud Kitchen. He has found a tiny mouse in his pocket, which reminds him of a tasty treat recipe to make with the Playtimers - pocket mouse pitta!

programme.title: The Dancing Bug Badge
programme.desc: When a dancing bug lands on Duggees head, he cant stop dancing. The Squirrels see that its a tiny hillbilly bug with a fiddle. And whats more, hes got a band with him - the Hillbilly Bug Band.

programme.title: The Teamwork Badge
programme.desc: A box full of bits and pieces is delivered to the Clubhouse and the Squirrels are excited. Duggee and the Squirrels are going to have to work hard to put it all together. Time for a bit of teamwork.

programme.title: The Pottery Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is having a lovely cup of tea in his favourite cup when Roly surprises him with a very loud peek-a-boo! It is so loud that Duggee jumps and drops his cup which shatters into pieces.

programme.title: Go Jet Academy: Wind Power
programme.desc: Its a very windy day at the Go Jet Academy as Jetpad comes in to land, zooming past the academys windfarm turbines. Meanwhile, in a field nearby, Grandmaster Glitch is teaching his grimbots a lesson all about wind power by trying to fly a giant kite. But as the kite is launched, the strong wind catches it and pulls Glitch up, up and away - and straight towards a huge spinning turbine!

programme.title: Bullet Train, Japan
programme.desc: In Japan, Grandmaster Glitch is at a railway station, wondering where his grimbots have gone. Some excited bleeps further down the platform reveal that theyve jumped into the drivers cabin of a bullet train and are happily pressing all the buttons! Glitch shouts at them to stop but its too late: he quickly jumps onboard as the doors slam shut and the train moves off - leaving the station without its driver. Meanwhile, at the next station, the Go Jetters are excitedly waiting with their ticke

programme.title: Diesel Glows Away
programme.desc: When notorious Diesel hides from the other engines, his plans backfire and he gets a surprise on Sodor.

programme.title: Fluff Bread
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck help the baker bake Shoku-pan, a light and fluffy type of Japanese bread.

programme.title: Moon Bow
programme.desc: Rainbow gets to experience the night for the first time.

programme.title: Sleepover
programme.desc: Stanley helps Hettie with a sleepover at the museum for some of the children. They do a treasure hunt and a night-time picnic, but antics ensue when they clean up after themselves.

programme.title: Portrait
programme.desc: Stanley is called to pose as a model for the towns art club, but hes got lots of jobs on and wont stay still. Peggy and the gang must come up with a way to keep Stanley still.

programme.title: I will get a Football for my Birthday.
programme.desc: Parties, presents, and lots of cake! The animals chat about everything they love about birthdays!

programme.title: Its time to pick strawberries
programme.desc: After going strawberry picking at the strawberry farm, JoJo and Gran Gran have lots of strawberries left over. So they decide to make delicious jam to preserve the berries for longer.

programme.title: Granny Mobile
programme.desc: Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter, but when a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin wont budge.

programme.title: Space
programme.desc: Mackenzie, Jack and Rusty are playing as astronauts on a mission to Mars, but during their journey, Mackenzie keeps going missing and no one knows why, not even Mackenzie.

programme.title: Smoochy Kiss
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and will not let Mum have a smoochy kiss. They try to hide him all around the house, but Mum is desperate to spend a little romance time with her husband.

programme.title: The Yoga Badge
programme.desc: Its one of those days. The squirrels have arrived and theyre all a little bit ... hyped up with bundles of energy. Things are starting to get a bit frantic, and Duggee needs to calm them all down. Fortunately, he has his Yoga Badge.

programme.title: The River Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right at the other end of the river, and a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his River badge!

programme.title: The Camping Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels are going camping. They need to find somewhere to pitch their tent but its not as easy as they thought it would be. They all work together and finally get settled. Then things start to unravel when the squirrels hear a scary noise outside the tent. What can it be? All sorts of things are imagined. DUGGEE!!

programme.title: Go to the Moon
programme.desc: Maisy wants to do one last thing before bedtime: visit the moon with her friends!

programme.title: Kittens
programme.desc: Maisy goes to Kikis house to play with some kittens, and one wants to come home with her!

programme.title: Corn
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, its Corn singing an A-maiz-ing Counting Song about his remarkably organised kernel rows.

programme.title: Orange
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, its the daring Orange attempting to cross the stage on a tightrope, if she manages to ignore any distractions.

programme.title: Peas Power Suit
programme.desc: Evil Pea becomes more powerful than Supertato by wearing a giant powersuit.

programme.title: Double Doughnut Rescue
programme.desc: Supertato almost quits being a superhero when he cant save two friends at the same time.

programme.title: Flamenco
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are flamenco dancing! Tinky Winky, Dispy, LaaLaa and Po are surprisingly good.

programme.title: Train
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say train and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different types of train - a long train, a fast train, a slow train and a choo-choo train. There is an animal train, a scrummy train made of food and everyone has a ride on a miniature train! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dees friend finally succeeds in saying todays word!

programme.title: Messy Breaks the Brakes
programme.desc: Messy accidentally removes the brakes from Mayor Okis carnival float, but it turns out he really needs them. Will Messy be able to stop the runaway float?

programme.title: The Clock Tower Heist
programme.desc: Somebody stole the big hand off the clock tower. Mojo and Bo are on the case, but it is not as simple as it seems. Soon, they are pulling off a heist they never expected.

programme.title: Relax
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo would rather explore their holiday hotel room than relax on the beach.

programme.title: Exercise
programme.desc: Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Blueys new employee in the middle of Dads backyard workout.

programme.title: The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and thats what shes supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: Its news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if hes got any news at all, remembers hes getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Calm Down
programme.desc: Water, water, everywhere - theres a flood in our hospital soap opera! Grown-up Tag the firefighter splashes around. Its a good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand.

programme.title: Stick Time
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? Whats Duggees favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.title: Solar Race: Australia
programme.desc: Glitchs hopes of winning a solar-powered race across the Australian outback are foiled when he crashes the Glitchster in the middle of the night.

programme.title: The Beach
programme.desc: As Mum goes for a walk along the beach, Bluey runs to catch up with her. Along the way, she has a series of encounters that both excite and test her in her first solo adventure.

programme.title: Muffin Cone
programme.desc: When Muffin cant stop sucking her thumb, she has to wear a cone of shame. But the cone gets in her way and she can no longer play sandwich shop with Bluey and Bingo.

programme.desc: Lay Lay and Sadie get assigned a school project with Cobo. The girls finally get to over over to his house and learn more about him, only for the girls to discover Cobo has a sister, who is even better at being Cobo, than Cobo is.

programme.title: Shes All Splat
programme.desc: With Cherry working at Splat by Sea, Max ropes her into a fake dating scheme to score partner discounts at the restaurant. Chloe faces a tough choice between winning a trivia competition or supporting her brother Billy when he wants to join her team.

programme.title: Meet Cute Crush
programme.desc: Henry and Ray try to help Piper carry out a meet cute with a new boy she likes from school.

programme.title: Spelling Bee Hard
programme.desc: Dr. Minyak challenges Captain Man to a Spelling Bee.

programme.title: Test Friends
programme.desc: Without them knowing, Captain Man puts Danger Force through a series of tests to see if he can trust them. But when the tests get out of hand, the tables turn on who can be trusted.

programme.title: iSams Mom
programme.desc: After fighting with her mom, Sam moves in with Carly, who soon realizes shes a horrible guest. Freddie is stalked by a dangerous criminal after catching him on video committing a crime.

programme.title: iPity The Nevel
programme.desc: When a video of Nevel yelling at a little girl surfaces on the internet, Nevel becomes hated by everyone. After celebrating Nevels demise, the iCarly gang then works to restore his honor after Nevel begs them for help.

programme.title: Cell Block
programme.desc: Sikowitz challenges the kids to go a week without using their phones, laptops or other portable electronic devices. The kids accept and quickly realize its not going to be as easy as they thought.

programme.title: MadAboutShoe
programme.desc: When Sam eats all of the moon meatballs Cat prepared for a Special Moon Dinner, Cat has to make more. Cat gets distracted when she finds a shoe and becomes obsessed with finding its matching pair.

programme.title: Rise of the Night Ninja
programme.desc: When Leo accidentally saves a subway station full of innocent people, hes inspired to take on a life of crime-fighting vigilantism as the Night Ninja! But has he met his match with the villainous La Fleur and her gang of dognappers?

programme.title: The Night Ninja Returns
programme.desc: The villainous, dog-hating madman known as SCRATCH holds the citys dogs hostage! His only demand? For the Night Ninja to surrender! But Leo, April and the Turtles realize theres more to Scratch than meets the eye.

programme.title: Potato Puff There Will Be Grease!
programme.desc: Mrs. Puffs new substitute teacher gives SpongeBob a crash course in driving. Mr. Krabs and Plankton must work together after discovering a well of miracle-grease under their restaurants.

programme.title: Big Bad Bubble Bass Sea-Man Sponge Haters Club
programme.desc: Karen tells the fairytale of a nerd trying to steal an action figure from his three little neighbors. Squidward hosts a secret We Hate SpongeBob Club at his house.

programme.title: Flower Power The Recipe Thief
programme.desc: Stan lures the Marsupilamis with the scent from his 100 year orchid, and manages to catch all three. Marcel steals Gran Grans recipe book after tasting Jade and Micas delicious sandwiches.

programme.title: One Better Day - Part 1 One Better Day - Part 2
programme.desc: Bettervale is celebrating Better Day but Best and Bester manage to anger the townsfolk by causing mischief again. After a period of exile Best and Bester return hoping to patch things up with their neighbours and with each other.

programme.title: Cactus Sitting Disaster of Hole 2
programme.desc: The twins take a cactus called Pricklebutt to the beach and end up mounting a dramatic search and rescue mission. Best and Bester wont let Grumpy Pants round of golf stop them from catching the finale of their favourite show.

programme.title: X Marks the Pot Patricks Alley
programme.desc: A classic villain returns to his former lair, only to find the Star Family inhabiting it. The Patrick Show rebrands for a younger audience.

programme.title: Pearl Wants to Be a Star Super Sitters
programme.desc: Pearl stars in a guest appearance on The Patrick Show. Patrick and SpongeBob go back in time to watch Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy when they were new.

programme.title: Survivoring
programme.desc: Cecil takes his kids camping, but Squidina wants the drama of reality TV.

programme.title: Dopey Dick Plankton and the Beanstalk
programme.desc: Squidward joins a crew of sailors hunting down the great white jellyfish. Plankton finds a magic bean that takes him to a land of giants well, more giant than usual.

programme.title: Not So Fast and Furious
programme.desc: A new super-fast villain is wreaking havoc in Secret Shores, and Billy is the only hope at tracking her down. After Billys speed accidentally triggers an avalanche, however, he decides to hang up his cape and retire from being a superhero.

programme.title: Test Friends
programme.desc: Without them knowing, Captain Man puts Danger Force through a series of tests to see if he can trust them. But when the tests get out of hand, the tables turn on who can be trusted.

programme.title: Opposite Universe
programme.desc: Henry and Charlotte are transported into an opposite universe where Ray and Schwoz are evil and want to destroy Piper. They must stop Evil Ray and Evil Schwoz and figure out how to get back to their universe.

programme.title: All Pets Are Off Brain Man
programme.desc: When Lana spots a lonely widow named Flo at Sunset Canyon, she sets out to find Flo the perfect pet. When Zach gets a perfect score on a state test, he believes hes a genius and decides not to study for an upcoming exam.

programme.title: Dance, Dance Resolution A Fair to Remember
programme.desc: Its the Sadie Hawkins dance at school and Lincolns sisters have accidentally landed him four dates! When Lincoln and Bobby become friends, Lori sets out to make Bobby jealous by hanging out with Clyde.

programme.title: Not a Loud
programme.desc: When Lincoln discovers the first page of his baby book is blank, he worries his parents are hiding something.

programme.title: Kiss of the Nematode Brainless Brawn
programme.desc: When SpongeBob unknowingly breaks a witchs curse, its victim insists on being cursed again. Larry begins to emulate Patrick when he finds out about his secret super strength.

programme.title: Squidferatu Slappy Days
programme.desc: Squidward ventures to Nosferatus castle after accidentally receiving his mail. Nosferatus minion Slappy kills some time around Bikini Bottom.

programme.title: Bubble Basss Tab
programme.desc: Bubble Bass avoids paying his bill at the Krusty Krab, so SpongeBob and Squidward are sent to collect the cash.

programme.title: Shell-shock The Amazing Coat Man
programme.desc: The twins and Marsupilamis save an egg from the Jaguar, which hatches into a baby crocodile. The Marsupilamis are helping people, and Callie wants to find out who the Amazing Coat Man hero is.

programme.title: Sea Haw Lil Past-cals
programme.desc: Patrick hosts a countrified variety show. The Kelpbed Kids travel to the future to get their kicking can back.

programme.title: Much Tofu About Nothing
programme.desc: Pat-Thos shares a Hamdonian tale of love and pork products.

programme.title: City Slickers Fool Me Twice
programme.desc: Lori and Lincoln visit the city. Lori struggles to be a city girl and Lincoln finds Ronnie Anne has changed. The family has a new plan to dodge Luans April Fools Day pranking: stunt doubles

programme.title: Europe Road Trip: A Knight to Remember
programme.desc: The Louds travel to London when Luna receives an invitation to Mick Swaggers knighting ceremony but get caught up in a special mission when Lincoln runs into a familiar face.

programme.title: Europe Road Trip: Nonna Your Business Europe Road Trip: Alpining Away
programme.desc: The Louds journey to Naples Italy to taste the worlds best pizza, made by a secretive and legendary chef. When Lynn crushes on a boy in the Swiss Alps, Lori and Leni become her crush coaches to help her talk to him.

programme.title: Europe Road Trip: A Bite of Transylvania Europe Road Trip: Greece is the Word
programme.desc: When the Louds bus gets a flat tire, theyre invited to stay the night in a spooky couples mysterious castle. During a tour of the Parthenon, Lincoln puts on a soldiers helmet which sends him back to Ancient Greece.

programme.title: Broken Alarm Karens Baby
programme.desc: SpongeBob breaks his precious alarm clock, but nothing else is loud enough to wake him up on time. Karen quickly learns that kids grow up too fast after her new child arrives in the mail.

programme.title: My Leg!
programme.desc: Now that Freds leg has healed up, SpongeBob is determined to keep it out of harms way...no matter what!

programme.title: Mass Gramp-nosis Cart of Darkness
programme.desc: Patrick hypnotizes everyone in Bikini Bottom into becoming GrandPats. Squidina leads Patrick on a grocery shopping mission.

programme.title: Rube Tube
programme.desc: On her day off from the Patrick Show, Squidina helps Rube produce his TV show.

programme.title: The Heat is on Dig disaster
programme.desc: Its the Chahutas Chili eating contest, and soon its revealed Marcels a cheat. When Hope takes Gran Grans special ladle to the park to play it ends up at Professor Lopezs archaeological dig.

programme.title: Hobblin the Goblin
programme.desc: The Morticians Club must stop the elementary school faculty from eating goblin-transforming cupcakes.

programme.title: Nobody Puts Baby In A Corral
programme.desc: Lily orchestrates a breakout with the other toddlers after shes put in Dairy Lands kiddie corral.

programme.title: Day of the Dad Small Blunder
programme.desc: Lori struggles to make a good impression on Bobbys dad after accidentally pushing him into a puddle. Desperate to have the best show-and-tell in class, Lily takes Lisas shrink ray to school.

programme.title: Friendiversary
programme.desc: SpongeBob celebrates the anniversary of his friendship with Squidward. Squidward does not.

programme.title: Blood Is Thicker Than Grease Dont Make Me Laugh
programme.desc: Planktons family open their own restaurant...directly next to the Chum Bucket. SpongeBob suddenly finds everything funny...much to everyones annoyance.

programme.title: Save the Date
programme.desc: Max bets Phoebe she cant turn off being a superhero and go on a normal date. Chloe helps Phoebe do well on the date, but Max tries to sabotage it by crying wolf. Suddenly, a real supervillain emerges and puts Max and Chloe in serious danger.

programme.title: Grand Theft Otto
programme.desc: Pipers school Parrot, Otto, starts to repeat Henry is Kid Danger. Henry and Jasper have to stall until Ray, Charlotte, and Schwoz can find a way to fix things.

programme.title: iMight Switch Schools
programme.desc: Carly learns that because of her web show shes been given the opportunity for a full scholarship to the elite private school, Briarwood. Carlys not so sure about it, but Sam and Freddie know they have to change her mind.

programme.title: The Worst Couple
programme.desc: Jade and Beck help Sinjin out with his game show, The Worst Couple, but find out more about their relationship than they bargained for. Meanwhile, Tori awaits the release of the new Pear phone.

programme.title: Judge Lay Lay
programme.desc: The Alexander family looks to Lay Lay to cast the deciding vote on family decisions, but the newfound power goes to her head, and one ruling causes a rift between her and Sadie.

programme.title: Fright Bite The Loudly Bones
programme.desc: When a vampire moves into Royal Woods, Lucy must convince him to turn the Morticians Club into vampires. Lisa discovers that the dinosaur bones she found in her backyard may not be what they seem.

programme.title: Time Trap!
programme.desc: When the kids break Mom and Dads priceless vase, they decide the only thing to do is go back in time to their wedding day, and prevent them from ever receiving it.

programme.title: Kings of the Con
programme.desc: Eager to be named Kings of the Con at the Ace Savvy convention, Lincoln and Clyde convince the sisters to go with them as the Full Deck. But the girls get more attention, leading the boys to do whatever it takes to gain focus.

programme.title: Witless of the Prosecution Time for the News
programme.desc: SpongeBob represents Patrick in Kid Court. Perch travels through time to cover historical events.

programme.title: The Grill is Gone The Night Patty
programme.desc: When a gang of kids steals the Krusty Krabs grill, SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs go to extreme lengths to win it back. SpongeBob helps out the Krusty Krabs night shift crew, but the customers crave something creepier than usual.

programme.title: Hamalot Garbage Dumped
programme.desc: After struggling to relate to Shelbys interests, Lance tries to bond with her at a live-action role-play event. Lana tries to save the town garbage mans job when she finds out the mayor is replacing him with an automated garbage truck.

programme.title: A Dish Come True
programme.desc: Lincoln starts to work at Dads restaurant when he hears that the best employee wins a dish named in their honor.

programme.title: Pet Project Cuff Break
programme.desc: When Mom and the twins win a raffle to spend a weekend at a resort, Lana struggles to leave her pets behind. After Lincoln tests a magic trick on Grouse, they get handcuffed together and Grouse has to spend the day at middle school.

programme.title: Delivery of Doom My Father the Boat
programme.desc: SpongeBob is challenged by E.V.I.L. to make a delivery to their secret lair in 10 minutes or less. When Mr. Krabs gets trapped inside of Pearls new boat, he must pretend to be its engine to avoid being caught.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.desc: 將繼續以音樂牽線，緣分發聲為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深薛之謙單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台！

programme.title: 我們的歌 第六季Singing With Legends Season 6 Repackaged
programme.desc: 節目煥新升級，打破原有賽制，以聽世界的聲音，唱我們的歌為主題，廣邀了劉宇寧毛不易馬嘉祺古巨基李克勤騰格爾龔琳娜等三十多位歌手平行演繹，回歸音樂本質，共同打造融合金曲，為歌手之間的合作與交流提供更多的可能性，打造充滿無限活力的音樂盛宴

programme.title: 食遇人間Food Encounters
programme.desc: 圍繞一道人間至味，一段人生故事的理念，由主持人王曉亞接收普通人的心願視頻，幫助心願委托人尋找特定食材，復刻一道承載著思念與牽掛的家鄉菜，並將其作為驚喜送給委托人心中最記掛的人

programme.title: 煥新環遊傳Travel With The Royal Family
programme.desc: 蔡少芬陶昕然斕曦張曉龍藍盈瑩陳思斯楊九郎時隔13年後首次合體重聚，以全新的面貌組成煥新團，從承載無數記憶的甄嬛傳拍攝地北京大觀園出發，自北向南，由東向西，前往全國多個寶藏民族文化發源地，通過深度探訪遊學，體驗各地民俗文化和風土人情，帶著回憶和新的憧憬環遊全國以完成煥新之旅

programme.title: 野火短劇Wildfire Mini drama
programme.desc: 戲子沈慕靈為追查師父離奇死亡的真相，結識了外表玩世不恭內心滿懷熱血的富家公子關行楷，兩人從最初的相互猜忌試探，到後來並肩作戰，在繁華鬧市的硝煙暗湧中，利用梨園戲台傳遞情報；他們不僅查明了真相，更在家國危難之際挺身而出，如星星野火般在亂世中燃燒自己，守護心中大義

programme.title: 勿擾飛升短劇Flying Up Without Disturb Mini drama
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師

programme.title: 大哥小助理Two Stars, One Boss
programme.desc: 兩位50娛樂圈前輩胡軍李乃文化身為經理人團隊，為具有代表性的年輕後輩藝人擔任經理人，全面負責藝人的行程安排，從接送機行程對接妝髮準備到工作陪伴突發危機處理...等；他們需要動用自己的人生智慧和圈內經驗，為藝人保駕護航

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季Love Never Comes Late Season 4

programme.title: 天水围的夜与雾Night and Fog

programme.title: 流氓驱魔师Chosen One, The

programme.title: 恶行之外Beyond The Sin

programme.title: 山忌 黄衣小飞侠Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo

programme.title: 暗色天堂Heaven in the Dark

programme.desc: 平陵一战锦绣国败军之际，红衣女射手付一笑惊天一箭射中夙砂大皇子凤随歌，随即扭转战局但付一笑却在平陵一战后不久，意外坠崖，记忆全失凤随歌也被人追杀疲于奔命，阴差阳错下，二人在正念山庄重逢看着失忆的付一笑，凤随歌只觉得此事处处透着蹊跷，于是决定将一笑带在身边，以引出操纵一切的幕后黑手二人也由此踏上了揭露两国间阴谋的旅程一路携手除敌党斗权相，寻真相，从互相利用到互生爱意成长励志The female archer in red, Fu Yixiao, shockingly shoots an arrow at Sushas eldest prince, Feng Suige, turning the tide of the battle. But Fu Yixiao accidentally falls off a cliff shortly after the battle and loses her memory. Feng Suige uses Fu Yixiao to find out the truth as to why he is being heavil...

programme.title: 猎罪图鉴 2Under the Skin II
programme.desc: 猎罪图鉴第二季将延续第一季的绘色显影，画见人心这一故事主轴，通过对画像的勾勒，洞悉人性的复杂模拟画像师沈翊刑警队长杜城等人组成的北江小分队，在第二季将继续拆解人性谜题，追击案件真凶The second season of crime investigative drama series Under the Skin sees Shen Yi, portraitist with the talent to accurately sketch and restore back the images of killers, and Interpol police captain Du Cheng, unite and work together again to hunt down killers and resolve crime cases.

programme.title: 地狱里长What The Hell is Love
programme.desc: 故事讲述每天黄昏5点20分就会见到鬼魂的热血里长罗一凡，在遇上笃信法律才能带来公平正义的菜鸟律师赵暖，与风度翩翩温暖浪漫的菁英律师温为仁后，一连串的突发案件接二连三地开始发生，伴随着信神与法律的冲突辩证，各类离奇悬案等待破解的同时，隐藏在三人间巨大的秘密也渐渐浮现

programme.title: 玉茗茶骨Glory
programme.desc: 年轻状元郎陆江来上任淳安县令后屡破奇案，却因卷入一桩杀妻旧案，从官场新星沦落至绝境濒死之际，幸得茶王之女荣善宝搭救两人联手整顿家族开拓茶道，在茶园里缔结了一段爱情佳话的故事After rising star magistrate Lu Jiang Lai is brought down by a past wife-murder case, hes left injured and on the run, only to be rescued by Rong Shan Bao, the Tea Kings daughter. Once rivals, she hides his identity and demotes him to a stable boy to exact revenge. As Lu Jiang Lai plays along to survive, he becomes entangled in the Rong familys high-stakes search for a son-in-law. Amid power plays an...

programme.title: 成为饭吧A Good Supper
programme.desc: 乡下小火车站周围有一家挂着饭店招牌的破旧白米饭店女高中生英信虽然是高三学生，但为了饭店的生意，骑着自行车每天急急忙忙地往市场跑，这是为了给来饭店解决一顿饭的客人准备一顿既便宜又温暖的晚餐英信从小就跟饭店老板京秀学做饮食后来饭店还来了跟着离婚的父亲，一夜之间开始了农村生活的正勋...被妈妈爸爸抛弃，被老奶奶养大的五福...还有双职工夫妇所以晚上主要在饭店吃饭的多情...这些同龄人从小时开始长达12年的晚上都聚集在饭店里吃同一桌饭，铸就了比亲兄弟更亲密的情感，比家人更紧密的联系

programme.title: 亲切的善珠Desperate Mrs Seongju

programme.title: 但愿人长久Teresa Teng
programme.desc: 本剧以邓丽君真人故事改编，讲述了华语世界永恒的声音邓丽君的传奇追梦历程，并展现了她从一个平凡的小女孩成长为走上世界舞台的超级女声的奋斗之路 Based on the life of legendary singer Teresa Teng, this biopic drama series follows her triumphant and successful career as one of Asias most popular and revered singer to the trials and tribulations in her personal life.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Pada Zaman Dahulu
programme.desc: Pada Zaman Dahulu adalah serial animasi yang mengangkat kisah fabel rakyat Melayu, terutama kecerdikan Sang Kancil. Cerita berpusat pada Aki yang menceritakan dongeng kepada dua cucunya, Aris dan Ara, yang tinggal bersamanya di kampung. Animasi ini mengandung nilai moral, nasihat kehidupan, dan hiburan.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Kiko
programme.desc: Animasi Kiko mengisahkan petualangan Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang mandiri dan riang, bersama empat sahabat setianya: Lola ikan diskus, Ting Ting kepiting, Patino ikan patin, dan Poli ikan cupang. Mereka menjalani berbagai kisah seru dan memecahkan masalah di bawah laut.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Zakstorm
programme.desc: Zak Storm menceritakan petualangan Zak Storm, seorang remaja yang tidak sengaja terhisap ke dalam Segitiga Bermuda saat kompetisi selancar. Di sana, ia menjadi kapten sebuah kapal bajak laut bernama Seven C, dan berteman dengan pedang ajaib bernama Calabrass, yang memungkinkannya berubah menjadi pahlawan pemberani. Bersama krunya yang unik, Zak berlayar mengarungi tujuh lautan di Segitiga Bermuda untuk mencari jalan pulang sambil menghadapi berbagai musuh kuat

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Entong
programme.desc: Animasi Entong adalah anak laki-laki Betawi berusia 10 tahun yang cerdas, saleh, dan ceria. Ia tinggal bersama ibunya, Fatimeh, di sebuah perkampungan setelah ayahnya meninggal. Kisah ini mengikuti petualangan harian Entong, persahabatannya, serta persaingannya dengan anak-anak lain seperti Memet.

Marlia, ibu Ira cukup marah dengan tindakan keluarga Reez kerana perkahwinan sepatutnya berlangsung sebulan sahaja lagi. Ira yang masih tidak diberitahu status hubungannya dengan Reez pergi mencuba baju pengantin. Reez sepatutnya datang bersama tetapi Reez terlamat tiba kerana tidak dibenarkan keluar oleh Rashid. Ira marah dan Reez merayu untuk bertemu dengan Ira. Reez akhirnya berterus terang dengan Ira yang dia dipaksa untuk berkahwin dengan Airine. Reez mahu kahwin lari dengan Ira. Ketika membawa kereta dengan perasaan marah terhadap Tengku Shahidan, kereta Reez terbabas dan Ira cedera parah. Di hospital Marlia bergaduh dengan Tengku Zaharah, ibu Reez. programme.desc: Mia terpaksa membuat keputusan penting antara Isa dan Jay, sambil menyelami jati dirinya sendiri.

programme.title: The Lift
programme.desc: Selepas sahabat baiknya hilang, seorang gadis kolej yang menghidap klaustrofobia mula menyiasat lif misteri tempat rakannya kali terakhir dilihat lif yang mungkin merupakan pintu ke dunia gelap yang menakutkan.

programme.title: Hysteria! EP8
programme.desc: Kebenaran akhirnya terbongkar dalam kemuncak yang penuh kejutan dan akibat besar kepada semua.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP6
programme.desc: Rina hidup dalam kesunyian selepas kehilangan ibunya dan membesar dengan luka yang tidak pernah sembuh. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad Que Haidar, penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: Golden Job
programme.desc: Sekumpulan bekas tentera upahan bersatu semula untuk merancang rompakan epik: meningkatkan trak penuh ubat yang dipegang oleh agensi perisikan asing untuk membekalkan kem pelarian yang memerlukan. Tetapi apabila mereka mendapati trak itu benar-benar dipenuhi dengan emas yang dicuri, kumpulan saudara-saudara itu menyedari bahawa mereka telah diserang dua kali oleh salah seorang daripada mereka sendiri - dan meletakkan keadaan yang betul akan menjadi perang habis-habisan.

programme.title: Siccin 7
programme.desc: Terpaksa meninggalkan kerjayanya sebagai doktor dan melarikan diri akibat satu perjanjian berdarah dengan sindiket mafia yang mengeksploitasi kanak-kanak pengemis, Kemal berpindah bersama keluarganya ke rumah agam milik bapa saudaranya.

programme.title: Hilang Kasyorga EP4
programme.desc: Rodi selamatkan beberapa kanak-kanak tapi bukan Kasyorga. Reza gagal patuhi arahan bunuh Esah. Rodi bunuh Reza dan Zaza. Rahsia terbongkar: Kasyorga masih hidup, tetapi diseksa.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Seorang sarjan Pasukan Operasi Khas Tentera Amerika Syarikat yang telah dibebaskan, James Harper, sanggup mempertaruhkan segalanya demi keluarganya apabila dia menyertai sebuah organisasi kontraktor swasta.

programme.title: Parole Examiner Lee EP8
programme.desc: Seo-yoon memperoleh keterangan saksi yang mengaitkan Myeong-seob dengan pembunuhan. Han-shin menemukan keterlibatan Myeong-seob dalam penyeludupan dadah penjara. Semua bukti kini menghala terus kepada Ojung Group.

programme.title: The Hidden Hand Dia Perempuan Sialan EP2
programme.desc: Riska pulih dan mula menjalankan tugasnya dengan pantas memenangi hati Nerina dan Syawal. Namun, semasa mengemas bilik Puan Sri yang telah lama ditinggalkan, Riska menemui peninggalan keluarga yang menyimpan kenangan perit.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP2
programme.desc: Perantara Siaful Azmi berkongsi pengalaman mengenai kisah penggali kubur di Pantai Dalam, Kuala Lumpur. Pekerjaan menggali kubur merupakan pekerjaan sambilan yang dilakukan secara tradisional. Perantara berjumpa dengan penggali kubur di sana, En. Jamian Man, En Ishak Hamilan dan Yussman Nordin yang berkongsi pengalaman bertemu dengan lembaga misteri dan kejadian menakutkan saperti berjumpa dengan lelaki berjubah putih, sekumpulan lembaga dan bunyi yang menakutkan. Perantara kemudiannya berada di kawasan tersebut bersama krew, mereka terdengar bungi menyeramkan, azan dan menjawab salam diberi.

programme.title: The Equalizer S3 EP6
programme.desc: Selepas remaja mati akibat pil fentanyl, seorang vigilante menyerang secara membabi buta dan McCall menjadi suspek utama dalam siasatan.

programme.title: Hysteria! EP5
programme.desc: Insiden tragis menguatkan paranoia. Keluarga mula terheret dalam konflik yang semakin berbahaya.

programme.title: Gateway
programme.desc: Sekumpulan penjenayah terdesak mencari perlindungan di rumah yang kelihatan seperti rumah biasa - tetapi mendapati ia menempatkan sesuatu yang jauh lebih jahat, dan lebih dunia lain, daripada yang mereka sangkakan pada mulanya

programme.title: Volkswagen Kuning
programme.desc: Filem ini diilhamkan oleh legenda urban terkenal Malaysia mengenai sebuah Volkswagen berwarna kuning yang misteri yang dilihat di Lebuhraya Karak. Mengikut legenda, apabila anda melihat kereta tersebut di lebuhraya, jangan sesekali memotongnya kerana kereta itu akan terus muncul di hadapan anda, dan yang lebih menakutkan, tiada pemandu yang dilihat mengemudi kereta tersebut.

programme.title: Bonnie
programme.desc: Bonnie, seorang remaja sekolah menengah, mempunyai masa lalu yang kelam. Walau bagaimanapun, berbekalkan kemahiran seni mempertahankan diri, dia mampu bertahan untuk melindungi dirinya malah orang-orangnya.

programme.title: Dont Blink
programme.desc: Sepuluh orang tiba di sebuah pusat peranginan pergunungan yang terpencil dan mendapati ia lengang sepenuhnya. Tanpa minyak untuk perjalanan pulang, para pengunjung terpaksa tinggal dan menyiasat misteri di sekitar pondok yang terbengkalai itu.

programme.title: Pelepas Saka
programme.desc: Sejak pulang ke kampung, Alisya sering diganggu dengan bayangan seorang wanita tua dan kadang-kala dia akan mendengar bunyi buaian yang berayun di luar rumah. Alisya juga sering diganggu dengan mimpi yang bukan-bukan menyebabkan dia terfikir-fikir apa yang sedang terjadi padanya. Suatu malam, usai saja majlis doa selamat di rumah Adnan, Asiah telah melakukan upacara melepaskan sakanya pada Haider. Setelah melepaskan sakanya, wajah Asiah berubah menjadi sangat tua dan badannya membongkok. Asiah hilang jejak selepas itu. Haider tidak menyedari bahawa dirinya kini didampingi oleh saka Asiah dan perangainya mula berubah. Dia menjadi panas-baran, suka makan telur mentah, sentiasa panas dan mula mengsyaki hubungan antara Raden dan Alisya. Raden juga diganggu oleh saka Asiah dengan menjelmakan diri sebagai Alisya. Raden mula tidak sedap hati dan memberitahu hal ini pada Adnan. Raden juga berusaha mencari punca setiap gangguan yang berlaku di rumah tersebut sehingga membawanya ke rumah Asiah. Di situ barulah Raden tahu tentang kisah yang terjadi.

programme.title: Mr Millennium
programme.desc: Disebabkan Jamil sudah terkenal, Qistina mahu menukar pakaian Jamil. Qistina yang sudah berjanji untuk menjaga Jamil tidak mahu lagi melepaskan peluang itu. Misi Qistina mahu membuatkan Jamil lebih terkenal dalam jagaannya. Jamil menyimpan pakaian persis pendekarnya itu ke dalam kain dan menggendongnya sementara dia menyarungkan baju suit hitam yang menampakkan kekacakan wajah Jamil. Jamil beritahu Qistina bahawa dia mahu mencari gelung misteri, dia berterus-terang bahawa isterinya Mastora pasti sedang menunggu di kampungnya. Jamil juga mengatakan dia datang ke sini melalui gelung misteri itu dan hal itu membuatkan Jamil ditertawakan oleh Qistina.

programme.title: Umar Hatta
programme.desc: Hatta telah melamar Leyla secara spontan, tanpa cincin dan suasana romantis. Kesungguhan Hatta membuatkan Leyla menerima lamaran itu dan bersetuju untuk berkahwin dengannya. programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam John Chiang is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In Julian Cheung and Kun Hao Kuan Ron Ng, to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying Kelly Cheung, Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan Samantha Ko. Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wans boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wans hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao Ins relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Mystic Nine Whats On Today
programme.desc: Mystic Nine tells the story of Zhang Qishan William Chan and Wu Laogou Joseph Zeng joining forces with Huo Xiangu Chen Yao and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into Food Guru, meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their favorite dish.

programme.title: Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the Gaigui Guided Tour to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various goddesses and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Tai Hang Yao
programme.desc: In 1939, during the harsh anti-Japanese war in the Taihang Mountains, Eighth Route Army soldiers were unable to care for their newborn children due to brutal battlefield conditions. Led by Wang Sanping, local village women from the Womens Rescue Association stepped up, risking their lives to raise and protect the soldiers infants. Facing constant enemy threats, these women forged a deep bond with the military through incredible sacrifice and bravery.

programme.title: Taste of Life
programme.desc: Chu-Tsai Chao and his wife have five children. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai becomes the prime suspect in a police murder case. He takes hostages at the police station and demands to negotiate with former negotiator Jun. As the two engage in a high-stake battle of wits, their expertise in psychological manipulation leads to a tense verbal sparring match, gradually shifting their positions and mind sets.

programme.title: Trending Topic
programme.desc: Chen Miao, an online media editor-in-chief, wrote a popular article which has become a trending topic. This however, led indirectly to a girls suicide. After receiving a help request, she realises that there is more to the story than meets the eye. As public opinion sways on the case, a war to speak up for the weak has begun!

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: Set in a snowbound, surreal Hong Kong, a tycoon who also secretly rules the drug trade is killed in an explosion, plunging the city into chaos. With police paralysed and the family businesses in turmoil, his youngest son vows to dismantle the familys empire, but is thwarted by his fugitive brother and his fathers followers fighting for control.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Confinement
programme.desc: Si Ling, a pregnant painter, moves into her dream home after winning an award and hires a confinement nanny. As she begins her one-month confinement after giving birth to her daughter, inexplicable incidents start happening in the house, threatening both her and her baby

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of brutal murders committed by a serial killer. Veteran detective Cham and rookie cop Will are assigned to the case. During the investigation, they encounter Wang Tao, who accidentally killed Chams wife. Seeking redemption, Wang assists them in tracking down the killer, but her involvement puts her in grave danger.

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends venture into a remote mountain for a photo shoot, unaware they have entered a forbidden area. As eerie incidents unfold, a mysterious boy in a yellow raincoat who leaps through the forest appears, leading them to uncover an ancient curse and terrifying secrets hidden deep within the mountain.

programme.title: Shadows Edge, The
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves pulls off a massive billion-dollar heist while outsmarting the Sky Eye surveillance system, shocking the city. To stop the criminals before they strike again, Macau police enlist retired surveillance expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild an elite tracking squad and hunt down the elusive mastermind behind the operation.

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Once a gangster, Li struggles to find work to pay for his fathers heart surgery. To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As Li discovers that the hotel serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and empathy.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident

programme.title: The Fierce Wife
programme.desc: An Zhen divorces her husband after his infidelity but faces a pivotal decision four years later - to return to her cheating husband and old life or to embark on a new life with a new love?

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous Gang Trio is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three Rob-B-Hood must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant
programme.desc: In a conservative society, a baby hatch that never closes sparks fierce moral controversy and public backlash. Despite mounting criticism and pressure, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie and Nuru remain steadfast in their mission to protect desperate mothers with nowhere else to turn, while offering abandoned newborns a fragile chance at life and hope.

programme.title: Moscow Mission
programme.desc: The story is based on a 1993 true event, the China-Russia Train Robbery where a gang of criminals commits a heist, stealing cash and goods from the cross border train. A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman heads the operation to arrest the criminals, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity
programme.desc: Ha Kung and Shek Kin are sworn brothers, but become sworn enemies in business and every aspect of life after Pinky, the girl they love, marries Ha Kung. It is only when the property owner of both their shops wants to terminate their tenancies forty years later, that they are able to resolve the rivalry.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: A gambling-addicted Fai is entrusted by his ex-girlfriend to care for their autistic son. What begins as a chaotic father-son relationship gradually becomes a journey of mutual redemption, helping him rediscover himself. When he discovers his sons talent for running, Fai resolves to leave the past behind and support his son in pursuing his dreams.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 2
programme.desc: In this sequel, Zhang Wu Ji successfully rescued the Six Major sects at Dadu. Nevertheless, the quest for the Dragon Sabre continues as Wu Ji and his three girlfriends set sail for Ice Fire Island. After a series of vicious fights, they finally unveil the secret behind the Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiaos fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Godfather Of Canton
programme.desc: A docker, Lin Si Hai, accidentally saves Commissioner Cheng who then offers him a position in the police force. Lin is smart and soon rises through the ranks through treachery and corruption, before becoming a gangster.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlords home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists cause with the stolen money?

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master the advanced Shaolin style kung fu, before Fang leads Hu and the Shaolin fellows to fight the enemies.

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fianc so as to drive away two women whom he does not like

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Lius disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her masters Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fans daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fans friend along the way.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The Generals henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brothers death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: West Chamber

The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her familys objection, so Hongs maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate

Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the Toad Stance and accidentally unveils his true identity

programme.title: Sunset

A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

This is Director Liu Chia Liangs masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.
